title: Affine finite-stage descent of a raw derived class
statement: Let k be a field and D:I→Over(Spec k) a small cofiltered diagram with qcqs structure maps and affine transitions. Let c be a cone whose underlying scheme cone is limiting, with qcqs apex. Fix q≥0, i∈I, affine etale V over c.pt, K in the bounded-below derived category of abelian etale sheaves over D_i, and z:Z[V][0]→c_i*K[q]. There are j∈I, affine etale W over D_j, a specified pullback square V→W over c_j, an object l of Over j, b:l.left→i, and y:Z[(D(l.hom))*W][0]→(D(b))*K[q] whose specified cartesianChartClassPullback equals z followed by the shift of the canonical inverse-image-composition isomorphism. All coefficient identifications are the canonical ones of [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image].

source.place: Tags 0EYL and 0GIT: affine etale model descent and continuity for a fixed bounded-below coefficient complex; first proof step of lem-sc-cartesian-raw-class-chart-representative

proof.text: Restrict the original diagram to Over i. The initial forgetful functor preserves its limit, so the affine etale model theorem gives a stage j over i and an affine etale model W of V.

Over Over j form the actual pullbacks W×_(D_j)D_l, with transition maps rawAffineRestrictedMap. Apply Over.pullback W.hom to the limiting slice cone. The symmetry isomorphisms of pullbacks identify this with the constructed diagram and cone. Every stage is affine, hence qcqs, and the transitions are affine by pullbackMap. The projections to D_i give a coherent fixed-coefficient system.

Use the existing proved exists_fixedDerivedCohomologyDiagram for this system. Apply derivedEtaleCohomology_limit; preservation of filtered colimits by the forgetful functor to types and joint surjectivity of a type colimit yield a stage cohomology element mapping to the evaluation of the original class transported by the free-representable pullback square.

Invert the fixed raw evaluation at that stage to obtain y. Cocone compatibility identifies its cohomology pullback with the original evaluation. Fixed raw evaluation naturality and injectivity at the apex then identify the corresponding raw derived pullback with the transported original class.

Precompose this equality with the free-representable square isomorphism and postcompose with the inverse shifted coefficient isomorphism. Cancel the two pairs of inverse maps; the remaining composite is exactly cartesianChartClassPullback. Cone equations supply b and the displayed coefficient comparison. This includes empty V and q=0.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_rawDerivedClass_affine_descent
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [∀ i, QuasiCompact (D.obj i).hom] [∀ i, QuasiSeparated (D.obj i).hom]
    [∀ {i j : I} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a).left]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget _).mapCone c))
    [QuasiCompact c.pt.hom] [QuasiSeparated c.pt.hom]
    (q : ℕ) (i : I) (V : c.pt.left.Etale) [IsAffine V.left]
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf (D.obj i).left.smallEtaleTopology
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (z : (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      ((abelianComparisonFree c.pt.left).obj V) ⟶
        ((D+(((c.π.app i).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}])).obj K)⟦(q : ℤ)⟧) :
    ∃ (j : I) (W : (D.obj j).left.Etale) (_ : IsAffine W.left)
      (r : V.left ⟶ W.left)
      (hr : IsPullback r V.hom W.hom (c.π.app j).left)
      (l : Over j) (b : l.left ⟶ i)
      (y : (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
        ((((D.map l.hom).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj
          ((abelianComparisonFree (D.obj j).left).obj W)) ⟶
        ((D+(((D.map b).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}])).obj K)⟦(q : ℤ)⟧),
      z ≫ (shiftFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).map
          ((upperStarCompDerivedPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (c.π.app l.left).left (D.map b).left (c.π.app i).left
            (congrArg (fun t ↦ t.left) (c.w b)).symm).hom.app K) =
        cartesianChartClassPullback (D.map l.hom).left (c.π.app l.left).left
          (c.π.app j).left (congrArg (fun t ↦ t.left) (c.w l.hom)).symm
          W V r hr _ (q : ℤ) y
